rule: C4 Unresolved references are preserved. A call the tool cannot resolve is still emitted as a low guess (`recv.m`, `.m`, a bare name). It is never dropped and never promoted to a resolved ID. | Typing reaches only declarations in the scan: ... A receiver whose type is only knowable from a library's signatures outside the scan (`project.tasks.named`, `entrySet().removeIf` on a JDK/Gradle type) stays a low guess, and that is correct.
notes: `var r = System.IO.File.OpenText(path)` gives r a type knowable only from a library signature outside the scan: r.ReadLine() is `recv.member`, low (Decisions 2026-11-09; not promoted to System.IO.StreamReader#ReadLine, C4/C5). Lookup(1).Trim() is a call on the result of a call with an argument: computed receiver `.Trim`, low. File.OpenText is written fully qualified: System.IO.File#OpenText, medium.
